meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多个对立视角审视故事，提前揪出潜在缺陷。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写用户故事,希望在交付前被多角度犀利挑刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your stories from multiple adversarial angles before shipping.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write user stories often and want sharp multi-perspective critique before handoff.

howto.what: 用户请它审查小说时，Claude会先做预检、读取审查标准，再从结构、角色、文字、设定等多个视角查找问题，最后输出带严重级别和可执行修改建议的审查报告；它只报告，不直接改稿。
howto.when: 当你说“审查一下”“帮我审一下”或使用 /story-review 等指令时触发；未指定模式时默认按 full 模式运行。

say.text: 审查一下我最新章节，重点找结构和节奏问题。
say.note: 会返回一份带严重级别和修改建议的报告。

say.text: 帮我审一下前五章，看角色语气是否各有特色。
say.note: 会从角色视角检查语言风格一致性。

say.text: 用 lean 模式审这一章，只查设定是否自洽。
say.note: 只会启用结构和一致性两个审查视角。

howto.what_en: When asked to review a story, Claude runs preflight checks, loads review criteria, then inspects the text from multiple adversarial perspectives (structure, characters, prose, setting). It outputs a report with severity levels and actionable fixes; it reports issues without editing files.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-review, /审查, or phrases like '审查一下' / '帮我审一下'; defaults to full mode when no mode is specified.

say_en.text: Review my latest chapter, focusing on structure and pacing.
say_en.note: Returns a report with S1–S4 severity levels.

say_en.text: Review the first five chapters and check if each character's voice is distinct.
Run a lean review on this chapter, only checking setting consistency.
say_en.note: Only uses structure and consistency perspectives.
